scientific_integrity: Exhaustiveness is symbolic. The cases \(p=3,5,7\) reduce to finite coefficient equations, while \(p\ge11\) is excluded by exact inequalities and divisibility. The bounded computational scan is only a regression check.
scientific_limitations: The theorem classifies only the squarefree family \(2pq\) with odd primes \(p<q\). It does not classify the general mixed-sign family \(2^a p^b q^c\) or higher prime support.
title: The mixed-sign two-divisor equation on squarefree \(2pq\)
